name: 09_tail_clause
description: S1 is redeemed at k × D_avg = 150 (tail cap 82.5 per unit); a liquidity event reported inside the 12-month tail pays holders at redemption up to the tail cap (excess refunded, tail exhausted), a later event is refused (NoTailDue), non-liquidity tail-period reports only advance the chain, and a period starting after the tail window is rejected (TailEnded). S2 was redeemed at its remaining cap, so no tail is ever due.

config.chainDomainNote: Bid/ask commitments, signed messages and the deployment domain depend on chain-specific wallet bytes and chain id; harnesses recompute them from the plaintext fields here (salts, prices, quantities, periods, nonces, prior/income commitments, liquidity flags) and sign with the keys derived from `keys[*].seed`. Amounts, periods and ledger values are chain-independent.
